blocks.text: Blockchain technology ki nayi ijaadein, jinhein Blockchain 2.0 kaha jata hai, bunyadi cryptocurrency se aage nayi aur behtar khoobiyan laati hain. Blockchain 2.0 mein smart contracts, decentralized applications (dApps) aur behtar scalability shamil hain.

Smart contracts khud chalne wale (self-executing) contracts hain jin ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hoti hain. Pehle se tay sharait poori hote hi yeh contract ki shartein khud nafiz kar dete hain, is liye darmiyani ki zaroorat kam ho jati hai.

Misal (Example): real estate (jaidad) mein smart contracts property ke len den ko khud kaar bana sakte hain. Jab tamam sharait, jaise adaigi aur milkiyat ki tasdeeq, poori ho jayein to contract khud chal jata hai: milkiyat khareedar ko aur raqam bechne wale ko muntaqil (transfer) ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain 2.0 bunyadi cryptocurrency se aage kya laata hai (exercise MCQ 10)? Blockchain 2.0 aur us ki advanced features bataiye (exercise long question 6).
blocks.explanation: MCQ 10: (b) decentralized applications aur smart contracts. Blockchain 2.0 sirf currency ke len den se aage barh kar blockchain par programs chalata hai: smart contracts (code mein likhi shartein jo khud chalti hain, maslan jaidad ki muntaqili), dApps (aisi applications jo kisi ek company ke server ki bajaye blockchain par chalti hain), aur behtar scalability (zyada transactions sambhalna).

items: Blockchain 2.0: smart contracts, dApps, enhanced scalability.
Smart contract: sharait poori hote hi khud chalna (jaidad ki misal).
